gloss: amount of damage; losses in monetary terms

definitions.gloss: amount of damage; value of losses suffered
definitions.explanation: The monetary value of harm suffered from a disaster, accident, theft, or fraud. Standard vocabulary in news reports and insurance paperwork.

examples.japanese: {被害額|ひがいがく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: The amount of damage is not yet known.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{被害額|ひがいがく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{百億円|ひゃくおくえん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}えた→超える：01942_koeru⟧。
examples.english: The damage from the typhoon exceeded ten billion yen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{詐欺|さぎ}→詐欺：09789_sagi⟧⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{被害額|ひがいがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧{三千万円|さんぜんまんえん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。
examples.english: Police announced that the losses in this fraud case came to about thirty million yen.

notes:
⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧ (damage, harm) plus ⟦{額|がく}→額：02607_gaku⟧ (sum, amount of money). Always about money — for physical extent of damage, use ⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧ or ⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{規模|きぼ}→規模：05095_kibo⟧.
